ex.en: The slow internet really frustrates me.
ex.zh: 網路這麼慢，真讓我很煩。

ex.en: I get frustrated when people are late.
ex.zh: 別人遲到時我會很不耐煩。

frustrate.en: to make someone feel annoyed because they cannot do what they want

ex.en: Bad weather frustrated our plans for the trip.
ex.zh: 壞天氣打亂了我們的旅行計畫。

ex.en: The delays frustrated our efforts to finish on time.
ex.zh: 延誤讓我們準時完工的努力落空。

frustrate.en: to stop a plan or effort from succeeding

ex.en: He owns a fast-food franchise.
ex.zh: 他經營一家速食加盟店。

ex.en: The company sells franchises to local owners.
ex.zh: 這家公司把加盟權賣給當地業者。

franchise.en: a business, or the right to sell a company's goods under its name

franchise.zh: 授權加盟、給予特許經營權

ex.en: The coffee chain plans to franchise its brand overseas.
ex.zh: 這家咖啡連鎖店計畫在海外開放品牌加盟。

ex.en: Most of their stores are franchised.
ex.zh: 他們大部分的店都是加盟店。

franchise.en: to give others the right to sell your company's goods under its name

ex.en: Tom doesn't even know how to fry an egg.
ex.zh: 湯姆連怎麼煎蛋都不會。

ex.en: I cannot fry these eggs. They are rotten.
ex.zh: 這些蛋壞掉了，不能拿來煎。

ex.en: I am going to fry an egg in a pan.
ex.zh: 我要用平底鍋煎一顆蛋。

fry.en: to cook food in hot oil

ex.en: Don't eat my french fries.
ex.zh: 別吃我的薯條。

ex.en: I'd like a burger and fries, please.
ex.zh: 我要一個漢堡和薯條，謝謝。

fry.en: thin pieces of potato cooked in hot oil

ex.en: She is a freelance graphic designer.
ex.zh: 她是自由接案的平面設計師。

ex.en: He does freelance translation on weekends.
ex.zh: 他週末接案做翻譯。

freelance.en: working for different companies instead of one employer

ex.en: The freighter arrived at the port this morning.
ex.zh: 貨輪今天早上抵達港口。

ex.en: The cargo was shipped on a freighter.
ex.zh: 這批貨物是用貨輪運送的。

freighter.en: a large ship or plane that carries goods

ex.en: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.
ex.zh: 學術造假比你想像的還普遍。

ex.en: The bank warned customers about credit card fraud.
ex.zh: 銀行提醒客戶注意信用卡詐騙。

ex.en: He was arrested for tax fraud.
ex.zh: 他因逃漏稅被捕。

fraud.en: the crime of tricking people to get money or an advantage

ex.en: The so-called expert turned out to be a fraud.
ex.zh: 那個所謂的專家結果是個騙子。

ex.en: I felt like a fraud on my first day at work.
ex.zh: 上班第一天，我覺得自己像個冒牌貨。

fraud.en: a person who pretends to be something they are not

ex.en: The town is near the frontier with France.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮靠近法國邊境。

ex.en: They crossed the frontier at night.
ex.zh: 他們在夜裡越過邊界。

frontier.en: the line where one country ends and another begins

ex.en: AI is the new frontier of technology.
ex.zh: 人工智慧是科技的新前沿。

ex.en: Scientists are pushing the frontiers of medicine.
ex.zh: 科學家正在拓展醫學的前沿。

frontier.en: the newest and most advanced area of a subject

ex.en: Only a fraction of the applicants were invited to interview.
ex.zh: 只有一小部分應徵者獲邀面試。

ex.en: The new model costs a fraction of the old one's price.
ex.zh: 新機型的價格只有舊款的幾分之一。

fraction.en: a very small part of something

ex.en: Students learn to add fractions in elementary school.
ex.zh: 學生在小學學分數的加法。

ex.en: Can you write 0.75 as a fraction?
ex.zh: 你能把 0.75 寫成分數嗎？

fraction.en: a number that shows a part of a whole, such as a half

ex.en: You can move freely around the office with this badge.
ex.zh: 有了這張識別證，你就可以在辦公室自由走動。

ex.en: Please speak freely; nothing will leave this room.
ex.zh: 請暢所欲言，這裡說的話不會外流。

freely.zh: （資訊、資源）可隨意取得地、免費地

ex.en: The software is freely available to all students.
ex.zh: 所有學生都可以免費使用這套軟體。

ex.en: This information is freely available online.
ex.zh: 這些資訊在網路上隨手可得。

freely.en: in a way that anyone can get or use

ex.en: He freely admitted his mistake.
ex.zh: 他坦白承認了自己的錯誤。

ex.en: She freely admits that she's not good at math.
ex.zh: 她坦承自己數學不好。

freely.en: in an honest and open way

ex.en: They live on the fringe of the city.
ex.zh: 他們住在城市的邊緣地帶。

ex.en: Only a small fringe of the group supports the idea.
ex.zh: 只有一小部分邊緣成員支持這個想法。

fringe.en: the outer edge of an area

ex.en: The job offers good fringe benefits.
ex.zh: 這份工作有很好的附加福利。

ex.en: Fringe benefits include free lunch and a gym.
ex.zh: 附加福利包括免費午餐和健身房。

fringe.en: extra things an employer gives besides pay

ex.en: She shouted in frustration.
ex.zh: 她沮喪地大叫。

ex.en: I understand your frustration with the delay.
ex.zh: 我能理解延誤讓你很沮喪。

frustration.en: the angry feeling of being unable to do what you want

ex.en: Don't fret about the small details.
ex.zh: 別為小細節煩惱。

ex.en: She fretted over the exam results all week.
ex.zh: 她整個禮拜都在為考試成績焦慮。

ex.en: The Swiss franc is a stable currency.
ex.zh: 瑞士法郎是一種穩定的貨幣。

ex.en: France used the franc before the euro.
ex.zh: 法國在使用歐元之前用的是法郎。

franc.en: the money used in Switzerland and some other countries

ex.en: Please do not answer this fraudulent e-mail and certainly do not click on the links in the e-mail.
ex.zh: 請不要回覆這封詐騙郵件，更不要點擊信中的連結。

ex.en: The bank detected a fraudulent transaction on my card.
ex.zh: 銀行偵測到我的卡片有一筆盜刷交易。

fraudulent.en: dishonest and meant to trick people

ex.en: I bumped into an old friend on the bus.
ex.zh: 我在公車上巧遇一位老朋友。

ex.en: You are very fortunate that you have such friends.
ex.zh: 你們很幸運有這樣的朋友。

ex.en: She's my best friend.
ex.zh: 她是我最好的朋友。

friend.en: a person you know well and like

ex.en: Ai finds it difficult to make friends with Ken.
ex.zh: 小愛覺得很難跟小健交朋友。

ex.en: It's easy to make friends at university.
ex.zh: 在大學很容易交到朋友。

friend.en: to begin to know someone as a close companion

ex.en: The coffee is free for all guests.
ex.zh: 咖啡供所有住客免費飲用。

ex.en: Admission to the museum is free.
ex.zh: 博物館免費入場。

ex.en: If I were free, I would accept your invitation.
ex.zh: 如果我有空，就會接受你的邀請。

ex.en: You should make better use of your free time.
ex.zh: 你應該更善用你的空閒時間。

ex.en: Are you free this Friday?
ex.zh: 你這個星期五有空嗎？

free.en: not busy and having time to do things

ex.en: You are free to leave at any time.
ex.zh: 你隨時都可以離開。

ex.en: Feel free to ask me questions.
ex.zh: 有問題儘管問我。

free.en: allowed to do what you like

ex.en: They freed the prisoner.
ex.zh: 他們釋放了囚犯。

ex.en: Tom freed the bird.
ex.zh: 湯姆把鳥放走了。

free.en: to let a person or animal go from prison or a cage

ex.en: There is a bank in front of the station.
ex.zh: 車站前面有一家銀行。

ex.en: The car pulled up in front of the bank.
ex.zh: 那輛車在銀行前面停了下來。

ex.en: Please let me off in front of that building.
ex.zh: 請讓我在那棟大樓前面下車。

front.en: in a position before someone or something

ex.en: I prefer to sit at the front of the bus.
ex.zh: 我比較喜歡坐在公車前面。

ex.en: The front of the building was painted blue.
ex.zh: 大樓正面漆成藍色。

front.en: the part of something that faces forward

ex.en: The front door is locked.
ex.zh: 前門鎖住了。

ex.en: Please wait at the front desk.
ex.zh: 請在櫃台等候。

front.en: at or near the part that faces forward

ex.en: Fresh fruits and vegetables are good for your health.
ex.zh: 新鮮蔬果對健康有益。

ex.en: The sight of fresh lobster gave me an appetite.
ex.zh: 看到新鮮的龍蝦，我胃口大開。

ex.en: This punnet of strawberries isn't too fresh any more.
ex.zh: 這盒草莓已經不太新鮮了。

fresh.en: recently made or picked and not yet bad

ex.en: Let's make a fresh start next year.
ex.zh: 我們明年重新開始吧。

ex.en: The new manager brought fresh ideas to the team.
ex.zh: 新經理為團隊帶來了新想法。

ex.en: I'm sure that this is a fresh water fish.
ex.zh: 我確定這是淡水魚。

ex.en: Fresh water is becoming scarce in many countries.
ex.zh: 許多國家的淡水越來越缺乏。

ex.en: Freedom of thought is guaranteed by the constitution.
ex.zh: 思想自由受到憲法保障。

ex.en: All kinds of rules made him lose his freedom.
ex.zh: 各種規定讓他失去了自由。

ex.en: I love the freedom of working from home.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡在家工作的自由。

freedom.en: the right to do or say what you want

ex.en: The frame itself is worth more than the picture.
ex.zh: 畫框比畫本身還值錢。

ex.en: They painted the window frames yellow.
ex.zh: 他們把窗框漆成黃色。

ex.en: I need to buy new spectacle frames.
ex.zh: 我需要買新的眼鏡框。

frame.en: a border that holds a picture, window or glasses

ex.en: I'm going to frame this photo.
ex.zh: 我要把這張照片裱框。

ex.en: The certificate was framed and hung on the wall.
ex.zh: 證書被裱框掛在牆上。

frame.en: to put a picture in a border

ex.en: He was framed by his wife.
ex.zh: 他被妻子陷害了。

ex.en: He claims he was framed by his partner.
ex.zh: 他聲稱自己被合夥人陷害。

frame.en: to make an innocent person seem guilty of a crime

ex.en: Tom told Mary that he didn't think John was friendly.
ex.zh: 湯姆告訴瑪麗，他覺得約翰不太友善。

ex.en: The hotel staff were very friendly.
ex.zh: 飯店員工都非常親切。

friendly.en: kind and pleasant to other people

ex.en: Cultural exchange programs can strengthen friendly relations between neighboring countries.
ex.zh: 文化交流計畫可以增進鄰國之間的友好關係。

ex.en: He is hardly friendly with his fellow workers.
ex.zh: 他和同事幾乎處不來。

friendly.en: showing a good and peaceful relationship

ex.en: This app is very user-friendly.
ex.zh: 這個 App 非常好用。

ex.en: We use packaging that is friendly to the environment.
ex.zh: 我們使用環保包裝。

friendly.en: easy to use or not harmful to something

ex.en: Please go to the supermarket to buy some fruit.
ex.zh: 請你去超市買些水果。

ex.en: Fresh fruits and vegetables are good for your health.
ex.zh: 新鮮蔬果有益健康。

ex.en: You should eat plenty of fruit to keep healthy.
ex.zh: 你應該多吃水果來保持健康。

fruit.en: a sweet food that grows on trees or plants

ex.en: Our success is the fruit of years of hard work.
ex.zh: 我們的成功是多年努力的成果。

ex.en: The new policy has begun to bear fruit.
ex.zh: 新政策已經開始見到成效。

ex.en: She was frequently late for school.
ex.zh: 她上學經常遲到。

ex.en: Tom frequently talks in his sleep.
ex.zh: 湯姆經常說夢話。

ex.en: How frequently do you check your mail?
ex.zh: 你多久查看一次郵件？

ex.en: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
ex.zh: 水是液體，結凍後就會變成固體。

ex.en: If you want to keep meat for long, freeze it.
ex.zh: 如果想讓肉保存久一點，就把它冷凍起來。

ex.en: I bought a bag of frozen corn.
ex.zh: 我買了一包冷凍玉米。

freeze.en: to become hard because of cold, or to make food very cold to keep it

ex.en: He froze with fear when he saw the snake.
ex.zh: 他看到蛇，嚇得僵在原地。

ex.en: Tom froze when the manager called his name.
ex.zh: 經理叫到湯姆的名字時，他整個人愣住了。

freeze.en: to stop moving suddenly, for example from fear

freeze.zh: 凍結（薪資、招聘等）；（電腦）當機

ex.en: The company has decided to freeze hiring.
ex.zh: 公司決定凍結招聘。

ex.en: My computer keeps freezing.
ex.zh: 我的電腦一直當機。

freeze.en: to stop something from changing or moving, or to stop a computer working

ex.en: Legal frameworks exist to hold war criminals accountable.
ex.zh: 法律架構的存在是為了讓戰犯負起責任。

ex.en: We need a clear framework for making decisions.
ex.zh: 我們需要一套清楚的決策架構。

framework.en: a set of rules or ideas that a system is based on

ex.en: CakePHP is a PHP framework.
ex.zh: CakePHP 是一個 PHP 框架。

ex.en: React is a popular JavaScript framework.
ex.zh: React 是很受歡迎的 JavaScript 框架。

framework.en: a set of ready-made tools used to build computer programs

ex.en: Scary movies will frighten the children.
ex.zh: 恐怖片會嚇到小孩。

ex.en: It wasn't until then that I felt really frightened.
ex.zh: 直到那時我才真的感到害怕。

ex.en: There is no need to be frightened. He won't harm you.
ex.zh: 不用怕，他不會傷害你的。

ex.en: The recent frequency of earthquakes makes us nervous.
ex.zh: 最近地震頻繁，讓我們很緊張。

ex.en: Increase the frequency of your workouts gradually.
ex.zh: 逐步增加運動的頻率。

ex.en: The radio station broadcasts on a different frequency.
ex.zh: 這個電台用另一個頻率播送。

ex.en: His visits became less frequent as time passed.
ex.zh: 隨著時間過去，他越來越少來拜訪了。

ex.en: She's a frequent visitor to this country.
ex.zh: 她經常來這個國家。

ex.en: He makes frequent business trips to Japan.
ex.zh: 他經常到日本出差。

ex.en: This café is frequented by students.
ex.zh: 這家咖啡廳的常客是學生。

ex.en: We used to frequent that restaurant.
ex.zh: 我們以前常去那家餐廳。

frequent.en: to go to a place often

ex.en: A few fragments of dead leaves floated on the pond.
ex.zh: 池塘上漂著幾片枯葉的碎片。

ex.en: Donald went to clean up the mirror fragments.
ex.zh: 唐納德去清理鏡子碎片。

ex.en: I only remember fragments of the dream.
ex.zh: 我只記得那個夢的片段。

fragment.en: a small piece that has broken off or is left of something

ex.en: Friction between the tires and the road slows the car.
ex.zh: 輪胎與路面的摩擦讓車子減速。

ex.en: Oil reduces friction between moving parts.
ex.zh: 潤滑油能減少零件之間的摩擦。

friction.en: the force that slows things when they rub together

ex.en: There is some friction between the two departments.
ex.zh: 兩個部門之間有些摩擦。

ex.en: The new policy caused friction among the staff.
ex.zh: 新政策在員工之間引起摩擦。

friction.en: disagreement or bad feeling between people

ex.en: Frankly speaking, I don't agree with you.
ex.zh: 坦白說，我不同意你的看法。

ex.en: Frankly speaking, I actually wanted to stay at home, instead of going out.
ex.zh: 老實說，我其實想待在家，不想出門。

ex.en: He frankly expressed his own view.
ex.zh: 他坦率地表達了自己的看法。

frankly.en: in an honest and direct way

ex.en: I envy the friendship Tom and Mary have.
ex.zh: 我很羨慕湯姆和瑪麗之間的友誼。

ex.en: I hope this is the beginning of a beautiful friendship.
ex.zh: 希望這是美好友誼的開始。

ex.en: By degrees the friendship between him and her grew into love.
ex.zh: 他們之間的友情慢慢發展成了愛情。

freshman.zh: 大學一年級學生、新鮮人

ex.en: As a freshman, she lived in the dormitory on campus.
ex.zh: 大一時，她住在校園裡的宿舍。

ex.en: The freshman class is the biggest in the school's history.
ex.zh: 這屆大一新生是學校史上人數最多的。

freshman.en: a student in the first year of college

ex.en: The teacher frowned when he saw the messy homework.
ex.zh: 老師看到凌亂的作業時皺起了眉頭。

ex.en: Many people frown on talking loudly on the train.
ex.zh: 許多人不贊成在火車上大聲講話。

frown.en: to bring your eyebrows together because you are unhappy or thinking

ex.en: She read the letter with a deep frown.
ex.zh: 她皺著眉頭讀完那封信。

ex.en: A frown crossed his face when he heard the price.
ex.zh: 他一聽到價錢，臉上就露出不悅的表情。

frown.en: a look on the face made by bringing the eyebrows together

ex.en: He felt like a freak because of the scar on his face.
ex.zh: 因為臉上的疤痕，他覺得自己像個怪物。

ex.en: The doctors called the illness a freak of nature.
ex.zh: 醫生們說這種病是大自然的反常現象。

freak.en: a person or thing that is very strange or unusual

ex.en: She broke her wrist in a freak accident at home.
ex.zh: 她在家裡發生了一場離奇的意外，摔斷了手腕。

ex.en: A freak storm hit the town in the middle of summer.
ex.zh: 盛夏時節，一場反常的暴風雨襲擊了小鎮。

ex.en: Forgive me for being frank. You have erred.
ex.zh: 恕我直言，你犯錯了。

ex.en: Let's be frank in this question.
ex.zh: 這個問題我們就坦白談吧。

ex.en: To be frank, I don't really like your new boyfriend.
ex.zh: 坦白說，我不太喜歡你的新男友。

frank.en: honest and direct in what you say

ex.en: The goods will be sent by air freight.
ex.zh: 這批貨會用空運寄出。

ex.en: Freight costs have risen sharply this year.
ex.zh: 今年貨運費用大幅上漲。

freight.en: goods carried from place to place by truck, ship or plane

ex.en: Our freight forwarder handles all the customs paperwork.
ex.zh: 我們的貨運代理負責處理所有報關文件。

ex.en: A good freight forwarder can save you time and money.
ex.zh: 好的貨運代理能幫你省時又省錢。

freight forwarder.en: a company that arranges the shipping of goods for others

ex.en: The discussion was fruitful and focused.
ex.zh: 這場討論富有成效，而且很聚焦。

ex.en: We had a fruitful exchange with the supplier.
ex.zh: 我們與供應商進行了富有成果的交流。

ex.en: Health coverage is an important fringe benefit.
ex.zh: 醫療保障是一項重要的附加福利。

ex.en: The package includes several fringe benefits.
ex.zh: 這份薪酬方案包含多項額外福利。

fringe benefit.en: an extra thing an employer gives besides pay

franchisee.zh: 加盟業者；被授權加盟者

ex.en: The franchisee must follow the brand guidelines.
ex.zh: 加盟業者必須遵守品牌規範。

ex.en: Each franchisee receives support from the head office.
ex.zh: 每位加盟業者都能獲得總部支援。

franchisee.en: a person who pays to run a business under a company's name

ex.en: The two countries support free trade.
ex.zh: 這兩個國家支持自由貿易。

ex.en: Free trade can lower prices for consumers.
ex.zh: 自由貿易可能降低消費者的購買成本。

free trade.en: trade between countries without limits or extra taxes

ex.en: He stomped on the fragile box, destroying its contents.
ex.zh: 他踐踏那箱易碎品，毀壞了裡面的物品。

ex.en: Please be careful with that box. It's fragile.
ex.zh: 請小心那個箱子，裡面是易碎品。

ex.en: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
ex.zh: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。

ex.en: She has asked the person at the front desk to connect her to that number.
ex.zh: 她請櫃檯人員幫她撥那個號碼。

ex.en: Make another appointment at the front desk.
ex.zh: 請到櫃檯另外預約。

front desk.en: the place in a hotel where guests arrive and get help

ex.en: They fractured their wrists.
ex.zh: 他們的手腕都骨折了。

ex.en: She fractured her leg while skiing.
ex.zh: 她滑雪時腿骨折了。

fracture.en: to break a bone or other hard thing

ex.en: The X-ray showed a small fracture in his arm.
ex.zh: X 光顯示他的手臂有輕微骨折。

ex.en: A hip fracture can be serious for older people.
ex.zh: 髖部骨折對長者來說可能很嚴重。

ex.en: The frightened child hid behind his mother.
ex.zh: 受驚的孩子躲到媽媽身後。

ex.zh: 突然的巨響把我嚇壞了。

ex.zh: 不要不敢在課堂上提問。

ex.zh: 湖面結冰了，所以我們可以走到對岸。

ex.zh: 我在超市買了一些冷凍蔬菜。

ex.zh: 我的手都凍僵了，請開暖氣。

ex.zh: 她從學校走路回家。

ex.zh: 我的表哥來自加拿大。

ex.zh: 根據我聽到的消息，這家店下個月要關了。

ex.zh: 法國以美食和葡萄酒聞名。

ex.zh: 巴黎是法國的首都。

ex.zh: 他們花了兩個星期遊覽法國。

french.zh: 法國的、法國人的、法語的

ex.en: She loves French bread and cheese.
ex.zh: 她很喜歡法式麵包和起司。

ex.zh: 我們為了慶祝我的生日去了一家法式餐廳。

ex.en: She is learning French because she wants to live in Paris.
ex.zh: 她正在學法語，因為她想住在巴黎。

ex.en: The French are famous for their cooking.
ex.zh: 法國人以烹飪聞名。

ex.en: We usually go out for dinner on Friday night.
ex.zh: 我們通常星期五晚上出去吃飯。

ex.en: The report is due next Friday, so I must hurry.
ex.zh: 報告下星期五要交，所以我得趕快。

ex.en: Friday is the last working day of the week for most people.
ex.zh: 對大多數人來說，星期五是一週中的最後一個工作日。

ex.zh: 法蘭西斯週末都在湖邊釣魚。

ex.en: I borrowed a ladder from Francis next door.
ex.zh: 我向隔壁的法蘭西斯借了一把梯子。

ex.en: Fred mows the lawn every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 佛瑞德每週六早上都會割草。

ex.en: Fred told us a funny story about his trip.
ex.zh: 佛瑞德跟我們說了一個關於他旅行的有趣故事。

freud.zh: （佛洛伊德，奧地利精神分析學家）

ex.zh: 西格蒙德·佛洛伊德是研究心理的奧地利醫生。

ex.en: Our psychology teacher talked about Freud today.
ex.zh: 我們的心理學老師今天談到了佛洛伊德。

ex.en: The kitchen smelled of freshly baked bread.
ex.zh: 廚房裡有剛出爐麵包的香味。

ex.en: She poured a cup of freshly made coffee.
ex.zh: 她倒了一杯剛煮好的咖啡。

ex.en: The wall was freshly painted, so we didn't touch it.
ex.zh: 牆壁剛油漆好，所以我們沒有碰它。

ex.en: A frog jumped into the pond with a splash.
ex.zh: 一隻青蛙撲通一聲跳進池塘。

ex.en: We could hear frogs singing after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨後我們聽得到青蛙在叫。

ex.en: The little girl kept a frog in a glass jar.
ex.zh: 小女孩把一隻青蛙養在玻璃罐裡。

ex.en: There is nothing to eat in the fridge.
ex.zh: 冰箱裡沒有東西可以吃。

ex.en: Please put the milk back in the fridge.
ex.zh: 請把牛奶放回冰箱。

ex.en: The fridge makes a strange noise at night.
ex.zh: 冰箱晚上會發出奇怪的聲音。

ex.en: The thunderstorm last night was really frightening.
ex.zh: 昨晚的雷雨真的很嚇人。

ex.en: It is frightening to walk alone on a dark street.
ex.zh: 一個人走在漆黑的街上令人害怕。

ex.en: The movie had a few frightening scenes, so the children covered their eyes.
ex.zh: 這部電影有幾幕很可怕的畫面，所以孩子們都遮住了眼睛。

ex.en: I ordered fried rice and a bowl of soup.
ex.zh: 我點了炒飯和一碗湯。

ex.en: He likes a fried egg on his toast.
ex.zh: 他喜歡在吐司上放一顆荷包蛋。

ex.en: Mom fried some fish for dinner last night.
ex.zh: 媽媽昨天晚上煎了一些魚當晚餐。

ex.en: He fried the vegetables in a little oil.
ex.zh: 他用少許油炒了蔬菜。

ex.en: It's freezing outside, so wear a thick coat.
ex.zh: 外面冷死了，所以要穿厚外套。

ex.en: The water was freezing, but we jumped in anyway.
ex.zh: 水冷得要命，但我們還是跳了進去。

freezing.zh: 結冰、冷凍（freeze 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The lake is freezing earlier than usual this year.
ex.zh: 今年湖面比往年更早結冰。

ex.zh: 她正把剩下的湯冷凍起來，留到下週吃。

ex.zh: 我們沿著高速公路開了大約兩個小時。

ex.en: The freeway was crowded during the holiday.
ex.zh: 假期期間高速公路上很擁擠。

ex.en: Take the next exit off the freeway to reach the museum.
ex.zh: 從高速公路下一個出口下去就能到博物館。

frustrating.zh: 令人沮喪的；令人挫折的

ex.en: It is frustrating to wait for a bus that never comes.
ex.zh: 等一輛一直不來的公車讓人很沮喪。

ex.en: The slow internet was frustrating during the online meeting.
ex.zh: 線上會議時網路很慢，真令人火大。

ex.en: She found the puzzle frustrating at first.
ex.zh: 一開始她覺得這個謎題很令人挫折。

freeman.zh: 自由民；享有公民權的人

ex.en: In the old town, a freeman had the right to trade freely.
ex.zh: 在古老的城鎮裡，自由民有自由經商的權利。

ex.en: The city gave the honor of freeman to the famous writer.
ex.zh: 這座城市把榮譽市民的稱號授予那位著名作家。

ex.zh: 在中世紀的議會裡，只有自由民才能投票。

ex.zh: 一位法國男子在火車上坐在我旁邊。

ex.zh: 感到挫折的學生們向老師請求更多協助。

ex.en: I'm frustrated because I can't find my keys.
ex.zh: 我找不到鑰匙，所以很懊惱。

ex.zh: 今天早上草地上結了霜。

ex.zh: 農夫擔心早霜會損害農作物。

ex.zh: 窗戶在夜裡結了一層霜。

ex.zh: 冷空氣讓玻璃結霜，我們看不到外面。

ex.zh: 把冰淇淋放回冷凍庫。

ex.zh: 我們把多的肉放在車庫的大冷凍櫃裡。

ex.zh: 客人到達前，她瘋狂似地打掃整個家。

ex.zh: 她慌慌張張地找著遺失的鑰匙。

ex.zh: 截止日前，辦公室裡一片忙亂。

ex.zh: 法蘭克福是德國的大城市，有繁忙的機場。

ex.zh: 新鮮咖啡的香味充滿了廚房。

ex.zh: 她慌亂地到處找她弄丟的鑰匙。

ex.zh: 學生們在時間用完前拚命寫下答案。

ex.zh: 廚房裡飄來新鮮麵包的香味。

ex.zh: 他大一時加入了一個兄弟會。

ex.zh: 這個兄弟會每年春天都會舉辦慈善活動。

ex.zh: 她在走廊上掛了幾幅裱框的海報。

ex.zh: 花瓶掉下去，碎成一片片散在地上。

ex.zh: 燈一熄，小孩嚇得尖叫起來。

ex.zh: 森林被切割成零碎片段，對當地野生動物造成傷害。

ex.zh: 教堂的天花板上畫滿了漂亮的壁畫。

ex.zh: 遊客排隊參觀博物館裡那幅著名的壁畫。

ex.zh: 他們的談話充滿緊張氣氛。

ex.zh: 她冷冷地對他笑了一下就走開了。

ex.zh: 這條繩子用了多年後開始磨損。

ex.zh: 瑪麗·雪萊寫了小說《科學怪人》。

ex.zh: 這套軟體成了創造者無法控制的科學怪人。

ex.zh: 法蘭克國王統治了西歐大部分地區。

ex.zh: 那是個結霜的早晨，草地一片白。

ex.zh: 她冷冷地看了他一眼就走開了。

ex.zh: 第一線的醫師日夜工作。

ex.zh: 士兵們上週被派往前線。

ex.zh: 遊客喜愛當地人的親切友善。

ex.zh: 她的友善讓新同學感到受歡迎。

ex.zh: 這家店以蔬菜新鮮聞名。

ex.zh: 我很喜歡早晨空氣的清新。

ex.zh: 她把巧克力糖霜抹在放涼的蛋糕上。

ex.zh: 這些杯子蛋糕的糖霜對我來說太多了。

ex.zh: 奶奶的虛弱讓全家人都很擔心。

ex.zh: 古書很脆弱，必須輕輕翻閱。

ex.zh: 一群瘋狂的人群衝向舞台。

ex.zh: 午餐尖峰時段，廚房一片忙亂。

ex.zh: 他穿著袖口磨損的外套。

ex.zh: 那條磨損的繩子終於斷了。

ex.en: The cloth frayed at the edges after many washes.
ex.zh: 那塊布洗了很多次後邊緣起毛了。

ex.zh: 截止日越近，她的神經越緊繃。

ex.zh: 他們有著維持數十年的兄弟情誼。

ex.zh: 結了霜的窗戶讓人很難看到外面。

ex.zh: 她買了一盞磨砂燈罩的檯燈，光線很柔和。

ex.en: He picked the frosted cupcake with pink sprinkles.
ex.zh: 他挑了那個鋪著糖霜、灑著粉紅糖粒的杯子蛋糕。

ex.en: The frosted cake looked too pretty to cut.
ex.zh: 那個抹了糖霜的蛋糕漂亮得讓人捨不得切。

ex.en: The dress had a white frill around the collar.
ex.zh: 那件洋裝的領口有一圈白色荷葉邊。

ex.en: It is a simple hotel with no frills.
ex.zh: 這是一間簡單、沒有多餘服務的旅館。

ex.en: She frilled the edges of the curtains with lace.
ex.zh: 她用蕾絲在窗簾邊緣做了皺邊。

ex.en: Grandma frilled the pillow cover to make it look prettier.
ex.zh: 奶奶在枕頭套上加了皺邊讓它更好看。

ex.en: The storm last night was frightful.
ex.zh: 昨晚的暴風雨真可怕。

ex.en: We had a frightful time finding a parking space.
ex.zh: 我們找停車位找得苦不堪言。

ex.en: We only have fragmentary records of the old village.
ex.zh: 我們對這個古老村落只有片段的紀錄。

ex.en: His memory of the accident was fragmentary.
ex.zh: 他對那場意外的記憶支離破碎。

ex.en: A large palm frond moved gently in the breeze.
ex.zh: 一片大棕櫚葉在微風中輕輕搖動。

ex.en: The fern's new fronds were bright green.
ex.zh: 那株蕨類的新葉是明亮的綠色。

ex.en: The fragility of the glass vase worried the movers.
ex.zh: 玻璃花瓶的易碎讓搬家工人很擔心。

ex.en: The crisis showed the fragility of the economy.
ex.zh: 這場危機顯示出經濟的脆弱。

ex.en: He hid his emotional fragility behind a smile.
ex.zh: 他用微笑掩飾自己情感上的脆弱。

ex.en: This tea has a sweet, fruity smell.
ex.zh: 這種茶有甜甜的水果香氣。

ex.en: I prefer a fruity white wine with dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐時我比較喜歡帶果香的白酒。

ex.en: The shop has a wide frontage on Main Street.
ex.zh: 這間店在主街上有很寬的門面。

ex.en: The house has a long river frontage.
ex.zh: 這棟房子有一大段臨河的土地。

ex.en: A frieze of dancing figures runs around the temple wall.
ex.zh: 神廟牆上有一圈舞者的飾帶。

ex.en: The museum keeps a marble frieze from ancient Greece.
ex.zh: 博物館收藏了一件古希臘的大理石飾帶。

freudian.zh: 佛洛伊德的；佛洛伊德學說的

ex.en: The professor gave a lecture on Freudian theory.
ex.zh: 教授講了一堂關於佛洛伊德學說的課。

ex.en: His Freudian slip made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 他那個佛洛伊德式的口誤讓大家都笑了。

ex.en: The navy sent a frigate to protect the merchant ships.
ex.zh: 海軍派出一艘護衛艦保護商船。

ex.en: An old wooden frigate is on display at the harbor.
ex.zh: 港口展示著一艘古老的木造帆艦。

ex.en: The market was full of frenetic activity before the holiday.
ex.zh: 假期前市場裡一片忙亂的景象。

ex.en: She worked at a frenetic pace to finish the project.
ex.zh: 她以近乎瘋狂的速度趕完這個專案。

ex.en: My parents are frugal and never waste food.
ex.zh: 我父母很節儉，從不浪費食物。

ex.en: She lived a frugal life and saved most of her salary.
ex.zh: 她過著節儉的生活，把大部分薪水都存了下來。

ex.en: The printer is on the fritz again.
ex.zh: 印表機又故障了。

ex.en: My phone has been on the fritz since I dropped it.
ex.zh: 我的手機自從摔過之後就一直時好時壞。

ex.en: The framers of the constitution spent months debating each clause.
ex.zh: 憲法的制定者花了好幾個月討論每一條條文。

ex.en: A local framer put my painting in a wooden frame.
ex.zh: 當地的裱框師傅幫我的畫裝上木框。

ex.en: They visited a Franciscan monastery on the hill.
ex.zh: 他們參觀了山丘上的聖方濟會修道院。

ex.en: The Franciscan order is known for its simple way of life.
ex.zh: 聖方濟會以簡樸的生活方式聞名。

ex.en: A Franciscan came to the village to help the poor.
ex.zh: 一位聖方濟會修士來到村裡幫助窮人。

ex.en: The old Franciscan spent his days caring for the garden.
ex.zh: 那位年老的方濟會修士整天照料花園。

ex.en: The pendulum swung to and fro.
ex.zh: 鐘擺來回擺動。

ex.en: She paced to and fro while waiting for the news.
ex.zh: 她等消息時來回踱步。

ex.en: She sipped a frothy cup of cappuccino.
ex.zh: 她啜飲著一杯泡沫豐富的卡布奇諾。

ex.en: The river became frothy where it crashed over the rocks.
ex.zh: 河水沖過岩石的地方泛起了白色泡沫。

ex.en: Open the window to freshen the room.
ex.zh: 打開窗戶讓房間空氣清新一點。

ex.en: A little lemon will freshen the taste of the water.
ex.zh: 加一點檸檬能讓水喝起來更清新。

ex.en: I'd like to freshen up before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐前我想先梳洗一下。

ex.en: She went to the restroom to freshen up.
ex.zh: 她去洗手間整理儀容。

ex.en: I appreciate your frankness about the problem.
ex.zh: 我很感謝你對這個問題的坦誠。

ex.en: She spoke with surprising frankness about her mistakes.
ex.zh: 她驚人坦率地談起自己的錯誤。

ex.en: The framing of the new house was finished in a week.
ex.zh: 新房子的結構骨架一週就完成了。

ex.en: The photographer chose a wooden framing for the picture.
ex.zh: 攝影師為這張照片選了木製的邊框。

ex.en: The framing of the question influenced how people answered.
ex.zh: 問題的提問方式影響了大家的回答。

ex.en: The media's framing of the story changed public opinion.
ex.zh: 媒體報導這則新聞的角度改變了輿論。

ex.en: He joined a frat during his first year of college.
ex.zh: 他大一時加入了一個兄弟會。

ex.en: The frat house throws a party every month.
ex.zh: 那間兄弟會會館每個月都辦派對。

ex.en: The price rose only fractionally this month.
ex.zh: 這個月價格只微微上漲。

ex.en: She moved her chair fractionally to the left.
ex.zh: 她把椅子往左挪了一點點。

ex.en: The waves left a white froth on the sand.
ex.zh: 海浪在沙灘上留下白色的泡沫。

ex.en: He wiped the milk froth off his upper lip.
ex.zh: 他擦掉上唇的奶泡。

ex.en: The river frothed as it rushed over the rocks.
ex.zh: 河水衝過岩石時泛起泡沫。

ex.en: Pour in the soda and watch it froth up.
ex.zh: 倒入汽水，看它冒出泡沫。

ex.en: A frisson of excitement ran through the crowd.
ex.zh: 一陣興奮的顫慄竄過人群。

ex.en: She felt a frisson of fear as the door creaked open.
ex.zh: 門嘎吱打開時，她感到一陣恐懼的戰慄。

ex.en: The fractious child refused to go to bed.
ex.zh: 那個難搞的孩子不肯上床睡覺。

ex.en: The fractious meeting ended without any decision.
ex.zh: 那場吵吵鬧鬧的會議沒有做出任何決定就結束了。

ex.en: The storm came frighteningly fast.
ex.zh: 暴風雨來得快得嚇人。

ex.en: The road was frighteningly narrow.
ex.zh: 那條路窄得讓人害怕。

ex.en: She wore a fringed jacket to the music festival.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件有流蘇的外套去音樂節。

ex.en: The lamp had a fringed shade in dark red.
ex.zh: 那盞燈有個深紅色、帶流蘇的燈罩。

ex.en: The lake is fringed with tall pine trees.
ex.zh: 湖的四周圍繞著高大的松樹。

ex.en: The beach, fringed by palms, was perfectly quiet.
ex.zh: 被棕櫚樹環繞的海灘十分寧靜。

ex.en: The little girl wore a frilly pink dress to the party.
ex.zh: 小女孩穿著一件粉紅色荷葉邊洋裝去參加派對。

ex.en: I don't like frilly curtains; I prefer plain ones.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡有很多褶邊的窗簾，我比較喜歡簡單的。

ex.en: The price rose by a fractional amount, almost nothing.
ex.zh: 價格只上漲了一點點，幾乎沒什麼差別。

ex.en: Only a fractional part of the budget was spent this month.
ex.zh: 這個月只花了預算的一小部分。

ex.en: The freed prisoners walked out into the sunlight.
ex.zh: 獲釋的囚犯走出來沐浴在陽光下。

ex.en: A freed bird flew straight up into the sky.
ex.zh: 一隻被放開的鳥直直飛向天空。

freed.zh: 釋放；使自由（free 的過去式）

ex.en: The firefighters freed the cat from the tree.
ex.zh: 消防員把貓從樹上救了下來。

ex.en: Moving to a smaller office freed some money for the team.
ex.zh: 搬到較小的辦公室為團隊省出了一些經費。

ex.en: A fracas broke out in the crowded bar.
ex.zh: 擁擠的酒吧裡爆發了一場吵鬧。

ex.en: The referee was caught in the fracas on the field.
ex.zh: 裁判被捲入場上的混亂爭吵。

ex.en: The shop gave out a freebie with every order.
ex.zh: 那家店每筆訂單都附贈一份免費贈品。

ex.en: I took the freebie pen from the booth.
ex.zh: 我從攤位上拿了免費贈送的筆。

ex.en: From now on, I'll get up earlier.
ex.zh: 從現在起，我會早點起床。

ex.en: From now on, please knock before you come in.
ex.zh: 從現在開始，進來前請先敲門。

from now on.en: starting at this moment and continuing in the future

ex.en: She makes all her bread from scratch every weekend.
ex.zh: 她每個週末都從頭開始自己做麵包。

ex.en: After the fire, the family had to build their life from scratch.
ex.zh: 火災後，這家人得從零開始重建生活。

from scratch.en: from the very beginning, without using anything ready-made

ex.en: We visit our grandparents from time to time.
ex.zh: 我們偶爾會去探望祖父母。

ex.en: He still calls me from time to time.
ex.zh: 他偶爾還是會打電話給我。

ex.en: From time to time, the bus is late in the rain.
ex.zh: 下雨時公車偶爾會誤點。
